response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong background in web technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. However, he critically lacks the mandatory 5 to 10 years of C++ development experience on the Windows platform required for this role, possessing only brief professional exposure to C/C++ from nearly a decade ago. Furthermore, while he has some general fintech experience, he does not possess the specific Fixed Income or Capital Markets domain expertise needed for this position.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience with strong capabilities in scripting languages and CI/CD pipelines.
Prior exposure to the financial and investment sector through his tenure at RIDE Capital.
Experience building low-latency applications and working with asynchronous I/O, albeit primarily using DLang rather than C++.
concerns: Critically lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ experience, having only about 6 months of professional C/C++ exposure from 2014-2015.
No demonstrated experience with C++ development specifically targeted for the Windows platform, heavily favoring Linux and web environments.
Missing the required deep domain expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, or specialized Capital Markets systems.
